groups.name: NASDAQ SETUP
groups.label: Cautiously Negative
groups.explanation:
⚠️ Material bearish change. Treasury yields remain the main pressure point, with the 2Y at 4.742% and the 10Y at 5.081%. Semiconductor momentum remains an important equity confirmation: SOXX has risen for 1 consecutive session. QQQ is -3.71% over five sessions and -3.25% versus its 20-day average. Brent is +1.51% at about $111.20, adding some inflation pressure.

The Nasdaq Setup is cautiously negative (-17/100, 56% confidence, deteriorating ↓). The current balance is persistent semiconductor momentum on the supportive side versus semiconductor/AI leaders trading below their earnings AVWAPs, rising volatility as the main headwind.

Near-term risk is concentrated in the 10Y yield is above the 5.05% headwind threshold at 5.081%, volatility is rising. Improvement in these conditions would strengthen the setup; further deterioration would reduce conviction.
